verified_facts.text: Montage Palmetto Bluff sits along the May River in South Carolina's Lowcountry, between Hilton Head Island and Savannah.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled along the May River in South Carolina’s Lowcountry, Montage Palmetto Bluff resort is set within a vibrant community between Hilton Head Island and Savannah.

verified_facts.text: The resort's accommodations include cottages, guestrooms, suites and village homes that reflect the Lowcountry's heritage.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our resort’s collection of spacious cottages, guestrooms, suites and village homes all pay homage to the Lowcountry’s rich heritage.

verified_facts.text: Spa Montage draws on the Coastal Carolina environment for a nature-inspired wellness experience.
verified_facts.excerpt: Incorporating elements of the Coastal Carolina environment, Spa Montage draws inspiration from nature to create an indigenous wellness experience.

verified_facts.text: Three-quarters of Palmetto Bluff is a protected nature reserve.
verified_facts.excerpt: Three-quarters of The Bluff, as locals call it, is a protected nature reserve.

verified_facts.text: The Inn is modeled after the historic mansion of Richard T. Wilson, a New York multimillionaire.
verified_facts.excerpt: reaching the Inn, modeled after the historic mansion of Richard T. Wilson, a New York multimillionaire who loved his South Carolina getaway

verified_facts.text: The resort is in the heart of Wilson Village, where the ruins of the Wilson mansion can still be seen.
verified_facts.excerpt: Montage Palmetto Bluff is in the heart of Wilson Village, where you can still see the mansion's ruins

verified_facts.text: The resort was formerly The Inn at Palmetto Bluff.
verified_facts.excerpt: Montage Palmetto Bluff (formerly The Inn at Palmetto Bluff)

verified_facts.text: The property has an on-site bird conservatory and a Jack Nicklaus-designed golf course.
verified_facts.excerpt: the property has an on-site bird conservatory, a Jack Nicklaus-designed golf course

verified_facts.text: Some cottages face the May River.
verified_facts.excerpt: Then, across the grounds are cottages, some facing the May River.

verified_facts.text: The River House hosts daily porching, with lemonade and cookies served on the screened-in porch.
verified_facts.excerpt: at the River House (formerly the main Inn), there's daily "porching" at 3:30 p.m., where they serve lemonade and cookies on the screened-in porch

verified_facts.text: The resort offers nightly s'mores by the fire pits.
verified_facts.excerpt: and nightly s'mores by the fire pits

verified_facts.text: The Canoe Club is the resort's fine-dining option, with water views.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Canoe Club is your fine-dining option, and it has breathtaking water views, ideal for dinner

verified_facts.text: Buffalo's, by the main square in Wilson Village, serves a Biscuit Bar at breakfast.
verified_facts.excerpt: by the main square in Wilson Village, Buffalo's is popular all-day that serves a famous Biscuit Bar at breakfast

verified_facts.text: At the Inn, the Octagon Porch and Bar serve a Southern-inflected menu.
verified_facts.excerpt: At the Inn, the Octagon Porch and Bar serve a Southern-inflected menu inside and on the porch.

verified_facts.text: The resort has canine ambassadors, dogs that roam the grounds.
verified_facts.excerpt: the canine ambassadors, the resort's set of precious dogs who are constantly roaming the grounds

verified_facts.text: Paintbox, the kids' club, has daily activities focused on the natural environment, wildlife and Lowcountry culture.
verified_facts.excerpt: Paintbox, the kids' club, has daily activities that lean into the resort's natural environment and wildlife, and Low Country culture.

verified_facts.text: On-site outfitters arrange boating on the river, island visits, kayaking, tubing and paddleboarding.
verified_facts.excerpt: tap the on-site outfitters for activities like boating on the river, visiting local islands, dock-jumping, kayaking, tubing, and paddleboarding

verified_facts.text: Alligators live in the area, so swimming in the river and lagoons is not advised.
verified_facts.excerpt: You've got riverfront and lagoon access, but don't you dare try to swim: Did we mention that gators live here!

verified_facts.text: Bike paths and golf carts are how guests get around the property.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bike paths and golf carts are how you get around

verified_facts.text: R.T.'s, the general store, has a deli, wine and local souvenirs.
verified_facts.excerpt: R.T.'s, the general store, has a fine deli and other treats, wine, classic candy, and local souvenirs
